definitions.fixed_population: All Stage70 geometry-sealed pairs are retained. Initial UU30 is followed unchanged to prefix13; final UU6 is separate.
definitions.point_reference: POINT is an unconditioned prior gap only while both endpoints are unobserved; other POINT gaps are point-only references.
definitions.shared_mean_shift: The same additive shift at both unobserved endpoints cancels in their objective gap; UU gap changes describe differential propagation, not a common intercept correction.
definitions.transition: Exact objective-gap signs versus the frozen unused label gap; a predicted tie counts as wrong for a nonzero label. Zero label gaps remain label_tie.
definitions.overshoot: An increment starts toward the label, crosses the label and ends with the wrong objective-gap sign; its absolute error may improve or worsen, reported separately.
definitions.interaction: The difference in subsequent point-local updates under the two initialized states. This is aggregate saved-state algebra, not attribution to individual observation anchors.
definitions.statistical_unit: Within-source-group summaries precede means across24 overlapping groups; pair counts are descriptive, not independent experiments.

limits: Frozen source labels use only2-3 repeats; leave-one sign stability and empirical feasibility are not truth or certificates.
No posterior covariance or target acquisition sampling margin can be reconstructed from these gap decompositions.
No interpolation scale, sampling temperature, weights or correction parameters are fitted or searched.
